description:
Found while landing fz-kdt.187 and fz-kdt.193 (2026-09-03, f986da97e). Same
defect CLASS fz-kdt.187 just cured for the dynamic tripwire, in a different
census.

fz-kdt.199 collapsed several fixtures to all-single-member construction
wrappers: with one member there is no selection plan at all
(select_construction_member takes the `None if members.len() == 1` branch), so
nothing dispatches. Measured from --dump backend=: 00277_enum_tier0_fixture
publishes 5 wrappers and behavior/enum_map_family 12, and NONE of the 17 has a
selection block; behavior/enum_predicate_search publishes 32, likewise none.

All three are still listed in WRAPPER_MEMBER_CENSUS (19 fixtures), which
drives the wrapper-order stress gates. A fixture with no selection plan cannot
exercise a WRAPPER-ORDER property, so those three rows compile a program and
assert nothing about the thing the census is for -- the census reads green
because there is nothing to read, exactly the failure fz-kdt.187 fixed for
SURFACE_MEMBERSHIP_CENSUS by asserting observations > 0 before pinning a
count.

THE FIX, mirroring fz-kdt.187: give the wrapper-order gates an observation
counter (how many selection plans this fixture actually presented) and assert
it is > 0 per row before pinning anything; then re-home or delete the rows
that read zero, recording the reason. Candidate re-homing subjects, measured:
behavior/enum_take_drop_split (23 of 38 wrappers multi-member with a selection
plan) and 00419_enum_take_mixed (4 of 4).

REPRODUCER: `fz2 interp --dump backend=/tmp/x.canon
fixtures2/behavior/enum_map_family.fz` then count blocks carrying a
`selection` line -- 0 of 12. Note the flag ORDER: --log-telemetry after the
subcommand truncates the fixture (fz-kdt.215).

CONCORDANT: fz-kdt.187 (the same cure, already landed, for the dynamic
census), fz-kdt.199 (the collapse that emptied these fixtures), fz-kdt.78
(explicit asserted gate ownership per fixtures2 source), fz-kdt.195 (the cost
of compiling census fixtures repeatedly -- deleting dead rows is also a
saving).

RED-FIRST: the three rows report zero selection plans and the gate fails;
green after re-homing or deletion with the reason recorded.
title: WRAPPER_MEMBER_CENSUS still names three fixtures that publish no selection plan at all, so a wrapper-order census drives subjects that cannot exercise it
